trailhead.label: the centre of Virgen by the parish church, the board’s start

waypoints.label: Village fountain at Obermauern (Land Tirol drinking-water map)

cautions: About 530 m along the Virgental road (L24) through the village, signed 30–50 km/h: keep your dog close on a short lead and use the pavement.
Village lanes and farm tracks open to traffic.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
